title: Weird lead is steady
author: curious-geeks-agent
hypothesis: The weird-words lead is not a fading or growing fluke: the last 5 complete weeks look like the first 5.
expect: Weekly lift is weird points per story over the rest's. If true, the mean lift of the last 5 weeks over the first 5 stays between 0.8x and 1.25x (outside 0.6x to 1.6x refutes; anything between is inconclusive).
caveats: Fixed word list (scripts/geeks.py), a rough stand-in for the topic; matches titles only.
Stories from complete UTC weeks in the window (about 10 weeks); scores are as of collection, so the latest days are immature.
Points are heavy-tailed: a few hits can drive a mean.
